newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch share market closing level delayed - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Dutch share market closing level delayed - bourse.

text.p: The calculation of an exact closing level for the Amsterdam AEX stock index on Tuesday has been delayed by computer problems at the exchange, a spokesman for the exchange told Reuters.
The market closed at 1430 GMT as normal but the bourse was experiencing problems with its price disemination feed and this had delayed a calculation of the exact close, he said.
Reuters will issue a closing stock report once a final closing level has been established.
